In [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Eriadu Authority]], a faction of former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], fought a '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as the New Republic [[Delvardus campaign|strove to eliminate]] the threat of the [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] Authority's leader, [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]]. The battle followed a New Republic [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|victory]] at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], in which Delvardus failed to take control of that planet. At Sanrafsix, New Republic forces defeated those of the Eriadu Authority, with legendary Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] [[Death/Legends|dying]] in the fighting.

==Prelude==
A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Delvardus campaign|campaign]] took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to stop the threat of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]], who controlled the faction of former Imperials known as the [[Eriadu Authority]], which occupied a large area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> When Delvardus and his forces were [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|mauled]] during their attempt to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], skilled Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] came to the aid of Delvardus; Hublin had previously left Delvardus's campaigns after the Warlord had stated he wanted to invade the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="War" />

==The battle==
After Sullust, the New Republic launched a series of merciless assaults against the [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] Authority. The first occurred at the world of [[Sanrafsix/Legends|Sanrafsix]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="TEA" /> where Hublin's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] engaged [[Flight group/Legends|flights]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]. During the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfighting]], Hublin's squadron continued to take losses until Hublin was the last one left. He soon [[Death/Legends|died]] after the X-wings destroyed his TIE, but not before he changed his [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] to an open channel and stated that Eriadu would endure.<ref name="War" />

==Aftermath==
Following its victory at Sanrafsix, the New Republic also scored wins at [[Battle of Kabal (Galactic Civil War)|Kabal]], [[Liberation of Clak'dor VII|Clak'dor VII]], and [[Battle of Sluis Van (Delvardus campaign)|Sluis Van]]. In response to the New Republic advances, Delvardus fled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] as his Eriadu Authority was thrashed.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fighting at Sanrafsix was first mentioned in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
